messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: P1 - rapid cuda_alloc_fail surge in pool= gpu-infer-west2 (nodes: infer-west2a-58, infer-west2a-59). Incident 89273 -> https://pagerduty.example/INCIDENTS/89273
PagerDuty: Incident 89273 fired and is paging the on-call rotation -> paging @oncall-alex
oncall-alex: acked. I'm on it, starting triage on infer-west2a-58. pulling nvml stats now
oncall-alex: nvml snapshot -> gpu0 mem 98%, processes: python(pid=4321, cmd=/srv/redwood/infer) repeated cudaMalloc retries, kworker showing OOM backoffs
eng-maya: seeing repeated kernel errors: 'CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED' and 'CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY' in the last 4m. pasting recent snippet:
```
[17:03:12] cuda: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[17:03:13] cublas: CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED at init_gemm
```
infra-jeri: taking nodes 58/59 out of rotation. draining infer-west2a-59 -> quarantine. scaling pool +2 replicas (intent: absorb traffic while we investigate)
ops-luca: initiating traffic reroute: active inferences from west2a -> west2b (fallback region). following runbook step 3 (/runbooks/gpu-oom): updating routing table and increasing concurrency cap on west2b
cs-maria: PS-172 customer reported elevated latency and 503s around 17:03. tagging customer success and adding to incident notes
oncall-alex: applying hotfix to evictor config: set `evict_threshold=0.7 -> 0.6` for gpu-infer nodes to be more aggressive on KV cache eviction, will monitor
oncall-alex: PagerDuty acknowledged by me, holding escalation for 10m while we observe metrics
incident-bot: PagerDuty Incident 89273 acknowledged by oncall-alex
eng-maya: after evictor tweak, observed memory drop on infer-west2a-58: 98% -> 65% within ~2m. no new cuda_alloc errors in logs for the last 3m
oncall-alex: marking incident as mitigated. leaving for infra to confirm quarantined node cleanup and repro plan. will file RCA
infra-jeri: drain complete for infer-west2a-59, infer-west2a-58 isolated. scheduling a full repro on staging and promoting an eviction policy patch to staging for validation
ops-luca: reroute finished, traffic stable, verification checks OK. CS confirms PS-172 recovered. :tada:
PagerDuty: Incident 89273 status changed to RESOLVED by oncall-alex
oncall-alex: adding post-incident notes: follow-up items = [full KV cache telemetry, tighter preflight cache evictions, add alert on cublas alloc rate]. I'll own the RCA.
